name: Notion
description: Notion workspace connector for managing tasks, databases and page documentation.

pages_read.name: Read Workspace Pages & Databases
pages_read.description: Query databases and read tasks and documentation.

pages_write.name: Manage Workspace Tasks & Pages
pages_write.description: Create, update and archive tasks and database pages.

tools.name: notion_query_database
tools.label: Query Notion Database
tools.description: Query items from a Notion database with optional filter and sorts. Returns matching pages.

database_id.description: UUID of the database to query.

status_filter.description: Optional filter by status name, e.g. 'In progress', 'Done'.

tools.name: notion_get_page
tools.label: Get Notion Page Details
tools.description: Retrieve full properties and metadata of a Notion page by page_id.

page_id.description: UUID of the page to retrieve.

tools.name: notion_create_page
tools.label: Create Notion Page / Task
tools.description: Create a new page/task inside a Notion database with given properties.

title.description: Title/Name of the new task or page.

properties.description: Key-value dictionary of Notion property values (Status, Due date, Assignee, etc.).

compensation.notes: Page did not exist prior to creation; undo archives the created page ID to Trash (SP-1 Section 1).

tools.name: notion_update_page_properties
tools.label: Update Notion Page Properties
tools.description: Update properties of an existing page (title, status, due date, tags, etc.).

page_id.description: UUID of the page to update.

compensation.notes: Roll back to pre-write snapshot properties, sanitized of computed fields (SP-1 Section 2).

tools.name: notion_archive_page
tools.label: Archive Notion Page
tools.description: Send a page to the Notion Trash.

page_id.description: UUID of the page to archive.

compensation.notes: Restore from Trash by calling update with { archived: false } (SP-1 Section 1).

tools.name: notion_create_comment
tools.label: Create Page Comment
tools.description: Add a permanent discussion comment to a Notion page.

compensation.notes: Notion API does not provide delete or edit comment endpoints (SP-1 line 24). Permanently irreversible.

tools.name: notion_delete_block
tools.label: Delete Block Permanently
tools.description: Delete a content block permanently from a page without trash recovery.

block_id.description: ID of the block to delete.
